mint_rule: Handler mints data.quantity one-for-one into qAR. The handler does not name the asset id.
burn_rule: Unwrap burns Tags.Quantity for a new X-Request-Id when the caller has balance. A later Withdraw or Unwrap-Funds-Sent is the evidence the row existed.
ratio_reason: Fifteen deposit groups have no agreed quantity, and the forwarded AR is mixed with other wallet balances. A 1:1 ratio is not applied to the whole supply.
